correctness.rationale: The piecewise map F has plateau H on the left, affine branch I-2u on J, plateau L on right; the affine branch takes the interior of K bijectively onto itself with inverse slope 1/2. Consequently F_*lambda_K=(1/2)lambda_K+aδ_H+bδ_L, a+b=1/2 and the two atoms swap. Continuous survivor mass after n steps is 2^-n, giving geometric first-cycle-hitting time and mean 2. Solving w=(a/2+b)+w/4 yields w=1/3+2b/3, with explicit a,b piecewise, and after 2n iterations the distribution is 4^-n lambda+(1-4^-n)(wδ_H+(1-w)δ_L), sharp TV 4^-n due to mutually singular continuous and atomic parts. The centered q=I/3 slope -2 causes paired phases h(q-t)+h(q+t)=1 by finite-doubling until plateaus. Independent exact rational checks cover representative parameter ratios including I=2B, I=3B. Universal analytic proof, not finite extrapolation.
